observations: Front view of a red and grey inverter welding machine.
Brand 'EDON' is printed on the top left of the control panel in photo 0.
Model 'MMA-400S' is printed on the center of the panel in photo 0.
Three red adjustment knobs for Hot Start, Arc Force, and Current.
Power switch and output terminals (+ and -) are visible.
A red plastic tag is attached to the front grille.
The unit appears to be in a retail or warehouse setting, resting on a yellow generator.
Watermark 'MUNICH INVESTMENTS' is visible across the center.
